summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of printing differences involving MatrixSymbols incorrectly. However, it introduces a non-minimal change and may not handle all edge cases.

issues.description: The change introduces a specific check for MatrixSymbol, which could be seen as a non-minimal solution. It might be better to handle this case more generally.
The patch may not cover all edge cases, such as nested expressions or other types of matrix operations.
